hint: Label shown in the widget header bar
label: Widget Title
name: widget_title

hint: Full display name of the company (e.g. Acme Corporation)
label: Company Name
name: company_name

hint: Short tagline or headline shown under the company name
label: Tagline
name: tagline

hint: Multi-sentence company description shown in the About tab
label: Description
name: description

hint: Full LinkedIn company page URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme/)
label: LinkedIn URL
name: linkedin_url

hint: LinkedIn company vanity name — the slug after /company/ in your URL. Used to render the official LinkedIn profile badge.
label: Vanity Name (slug)
name: vanity_name

hint: Numeric LinkedIn company ID — required for the Follow button embed. Find it in your LinkedIn Admin panel.
label: Company ID (numeric)
name: company_id

hint: URL to the company logo image (square, min 100×100px)
label: Logo URL
name: logo_url

hint: URL to a banner/cover image (recommended 1128×191px). Leave blank for the default gradient.
label: Banner Image URL
name: banner_url

hint: Company website URL shown in the About tab
label: Website
name: website

hint: Headquarters city/country shown in About tab
label: Headquarters
name: headquarters

hint: Short location string shown in the profile card (e.g. San Francisco, CA)
label: Location (short)
name: location

hint: Approximate follower count (numeric). Displayed in the profile card meta row.
label: Follower Count
name: followers

hint: JSON array of featured posts. Each item: {"text":"...","date":"...","url":"..."}
label: Featured Posts (JSON)
name: featured_posts
